chunks.text: In the app, search for Lock card, choose your card, then use the temporary-lock button. In Online Banking, open Service, then Card services, choose the temporary-lock option, select your card and confirm.
conditions: Use a temporary lock when a misplaced card might be found. If it cannot be found, report it lost or stolen.

chunks.text: The temporary lock lasts 15 days and then lifts automatically. You can unlock sooner if you find the card. Cancel the card if it remains missing after 15 days.
The lock also covers additional cardholders, Digital Cards, PartPay, mobile wallets and wearables. Direct debits and recurring card payments may be declined.
In the app, use the same temporary-lock button again. In Online Banking, repeat the locking route and choose Unlock.
conditions: Only unlock a card you have found.

chunks.text: You can change your email, mobile number or address. In the latest app, search for Update contact details, edit the relevant field and save. In Online Banking, navigate through Services, Preferences and Personal details, then Personal and Contact Details. Complete the SMS verification, make your changes and save.
conditions: Online updates require registration for Westpac Protect Security Code and a one-time password. Enter verification codes only in the official bank service.

chunks.text: Red is Westpac’s existing virtual assistant for everyday banking questions, available around the clock in English. It provides factual self-service guidance rather than personalised product advice.
conditions: When Red cannot answer, a human chat option may be offered, or you can contact the bank directly.

chunks.text: In the latest app, open Contact us and then Chat with us. In Online Banking, use the help/chat popup at the bottom left of the main dashboard.

Westpac’s published AI principles address wellbeing; human rights, diversity and autonomy; fairness; privacy and security; transparency; contestability; accountability and human oversight; and reliable, safe operation. These principles guide the design, delivery, deployment and use of its AI systems.
conditions: This public statement does not describe or verify the bank’s internal technical implementation.
